⭐ Centered Spiritual Halt

Sri Kshetra Hornadu Annapoorneshwari

Surrounded by dense Sahyadri coffee valleys. Your overnight halt on Saturday, Nov 21 grants access to the evening Maha Mangalarathi, golden palanquin seva, and the legendary Annaprasadam.

★ MANDATORY OVERNIGHT STAY 🛏️ Bhadra / Annapoorna Guest Houses
⛰️ Ghat Daylight Navigation Radar
🧭 Arabail Ghat NH52 Yellapur down to Ankola. Smooth asphalt, scenic curves. Day 1 (Pass by 4:00 PM)
🌉 Sigandur Link Sharavathi Cable Bridge. Skips lengthy vehicle ferry queues. Day 2 (Cross at 2:00 PM)
⛅ Charmadi Ghat Kottigehara down to Belthangady. Dramatic drop, daylight mandatory. Day 4 (Morning Window)
🛣️ Shiradi Ghat Gundya up to Sakleshpur. 4-lane concrete, safe uphill climb. Day 5 (Morning Window)
🛡️ Temple Sanctum Protocols
👗
Dress Code Strictness

Gokarna, Dharmasthala, Kukke: Men must remove shirts and vests before entering inner garbha-griha; plain dhotis/veshtis required. Women: Sarees or traditional salwar suits.

🍽️
Temple Mahaprasadam Timings

Sringeri & Dharmasthala: Free afternoon annadana runs 12:15 PM – 2:30 PM. Pristine satvik meals served on banana leaves.

🛗
Senior & Knee-Friendly Hacks

At Murudeshwar, use the fast elevator to the 18th floor of the Raja Gopura (zero stairs). At Sigandur, vehicular access directly reaches temple approach.
